title: 12″ Gear Premium 7mm Beaker Bong
description: The Gear Premium 12” 7 mm Beaker is adorned with the Debossed GEAR Premium logo for a stunning outlook and engineered with 100% borosilicate glass for top-end durability. Besides, the beaker owns great features, such as, an extra thick female joint, extra-large Blaster pull-out, flat mouthpiece, etc…
